slot_done.excerpt:
58  
  59  func completed(bytes: PackedByteArray, expected: Dictionary) -> String:
  60  	# A corrupt payload must never release a slot. The out-of-band expected
  61  	# identity belongs to the callback closure, not to untrusted GPU bytes.
  62  	if not _matches(expected): return "stale_lease"
  63  	if slots[expected.slot_id].state != State.GPU_QUEUED: return "duplicate_or_wrong_state"
  64  	var result := Wire.decode_completion(bytes)
  65  	if not result.error.is_empty(): return result.error
  66  	if not Wire.same_lease(result, expected): return "completion_identity"
  67  	slots[expected.slot_id].state = State.GPU_COMPLETE
  68  	slots[expected.slot_id].completion = result
  69  	_event("gpu_complete", expected)
  70  	return ""
